displayName: Edits to total actual cost will be spread to the status date (User)
description:
Distributes the changes to total actual cost evenly across the schedule to the status date (or to the current date if you have not specified a project status date).

If you enable this setting, Project will distribute edits to actual cost evenly across a task up to the status date.

If you disable or do not configure this setting, the user's default setting is used.
